rule: No process-global mutable state in the gwz-py native layer: pass it through the session/operation context (GwzCoreSessionDesign O9). This list is the complete inventory of production exceptions. gwz-core's check_process_globals.py, run by src/tests/test_process_globals.py, fails on anything unlisted and on entries that no longer match, so the list only shrinks.

entries.name: REGISTRY
entries.reason: Process-global diff output registry; becomes a member of the session context (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: env::current_dir
entries.reason: Reads the process working directory on every native call, and another Python thread may chdir concurrently. The Python API must pass the start directory explicitly.

entries.name: REGISTRY
entries.reason: Process-global commit-log output registry; becomes a member of the session context (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: env::var
entries.reason: Test event-delay hook (GWZ_PY_TEST_EVENT_DELAY_MS) read from the environment in production builds; move it behind a test-only hook.

entries.name: STORE
entries.reason: Process-global legacy operation store; becomes a member of the session context (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: SCOPED_STORE
entries.reason: Thread-local store scoping added by the retired Python session train; replace with an explicit parameter from the operation's gate (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: SCOPED_BACKEND
entries.reason: Thread-local backend scoping; replace with an explicit parameter from the operation's gate (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: SCOPED_OPERATION_ID
entries.reason: Thread-local operation-ID scoping; replace with an explicit parameter from the operation's gate (RemPlan B5).

entries.name: env::current_dir
entries.reason: As native/src/lib.rs: the start directory must come from the caller.

entries.name: CURRENT_SESSION
entries.reason: Thread-local current-session scoping; replace with an explicit parameter (RemPlan B5).
